description.value: TikiCAB is Tofino's locally owned minibus operator running on-demand Call-A-Bus service (suspended mid-June to mid-September), a summer free shuttle between downtown Tofino and Cox Bay Info Centre, and airport transfers to Tofino-Long Beach Airport (CYAZ). No bike policy is stated on the site.
